arguments.prompt: Create one isolated Cartoon water effect for SPLASH.BMP frame004. First input is the exact original sprite: preserve its particular silhouette, proportions, relative positioning of parts, open transparent areas and number of significant tongues/drops. White source shapes are actual foam; black background is transparent and any dark diagnostic contour must not become dark water. Required form: A tall upward water column/trumpet: narrow lower stem with a small base, flaring into a wide V-shaped sheet near the top. The left tip extends upper-left, the right branches higher into a curved thin jet toward upper-right with a few separate drops; a short central prong stays lower. Pale water streams drain down the narrow central stem to the small crown at bottom. Keep this vertically connected splash silhouette and original asymmetric branches; do not copy000's detached umbrella composition. Second input is a shared water materials/style key ONLY, not pose or amount of water. Use clean luminous white foam, pale cyan/light-blue restrained cel shading and thin medium-blue contour accents. NO heavy black outline, navy shadow, dark cast shadow, dark puddle, gray haze or glow. No animals, ground, scenery, ocean horizon or text. Do not turn thin open source forms into a generic solid mound. Real alpha transparency in all background and holes. Complete shape and every droplet fully inside a comfortably padded canvas. Crisp smooth Cartoon artwork, not literal pixel art.
